def run_http_server():
    print("Starting HTTP Server on port 8090...")
    server = HTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8090), SimpleHTTPRequestHandler)
    server.serve_forever()
if __name__ == "__main__":
    t = threading.Thread(target=run_http_server, daemon=True)
    t.start()
    asyncio.run(main())
